#          otherwise one of: pip, npm, dpkg, apt, git, python, node
# weight: higher = more specific / more trustworthy match.
#   1-2  generic catch-alls (only ever win if nothing else matched)
#   7-8  specific state signatures (dpkg status strings, etc.)
# Adding a new rule never needs to worry about position in this file:
# ranking is purely by weight + context match, not by line order.

column1: # Generic catch-all: lowest weight on purpose. It will only ever "win" if
# no specific rule above also matched. This is the fix for the bug where
